# VANCOMYCIN:

# Recommended Vancomycin Preop Dose based on patient weight:

Preop dose administer beginning 120 minutes before incision:

# Weight <70 kg:
Vancomycin 1000 mg IV ONCE

# Weight 70-100 kg:

Vancomycin 1500 mg IV ONCE

# Weight >100 kg:

Vancomycin 2000 mg IV ONCE
Inpt: ORZID2 GMENU SURG VANCOMYCIN WEIGHT BASED DOSING
Outpt: ORZID2 GMENU SURG VANCOMYCIN WEIGHT BASED DOSING
